arms.shipped: the registered default: W = 3 corridor witnesses, clearance factor 0.5
arms.w1: the corridor certified against the nearest background centre only
arms.w2: the corridor certified against the two nearest background centres
arms.exact: the corridor certified against every background centre (O(m) per pair)
arms.vacuous: corridor clearance factor -1, i.e. the corridor clause removed

claim: On every unit of every reported cohort the shipped corridor certificate returns the same partition, the same fragment-edge count and the same metrics as each smaller witness count, as the exact full scan, and as a configuration in which the corridor clause cannot reject anything, and it reproduces the frozen result files. Lemma corridor-lemma predicts this: at the registered closeness factor 0.5 the corridor clearance obtained is 1.5 * d_ij, three times the 0.5 * d_ij the clause requires, so the clause cannot reject a pair the closeness test admitted and the witness count cannot matter.
